title: Garmin Fenix 8, 47mm AMOLED Sapphire Smartwatch Grey Bezel $997 Titanium $999 @ Amazon AU @ Rebel Sports @ HN @ JB-Hifi
body:
Deal: Garmin Fenix 8, 47mm AMOLED Sapphire Smartwatch Grey Bezel $997 Titanium $999 @ Amazon AU @ Rebel Sports @ HN @ JB-Hifi

[RandomDealHunter] Garmin’s official website has it too and the deal is valid till 24 Dec.
[itshammer] am I crazy for wanting the solar in sapphire instead?
I'm looking at upgrading from a fenix 5x to get ECG and I assume it supports pay?
[Fredfloresjr] If ya doing 50 days race straight in the middle of jungle then yes
[smartialarts] Does support pay, quite a handy feature, confirming that.
[ATTS] Does epix pro 2 have ecg aswell? Google says yes but i didn't think i saw the feature when settling up
[smartialarts] Damn it, bought couple of days ago from JB Hi-Fi via price matching Amazon deal of ~$1200, thought it was not likely to go any lower.
This gotta be an ATL.
[smartialarts] All is well in paradise.
Contacted the big JB and they graciously agreed to refund the difference. It's not a policy but a "goodwill gesture" and you can request it within 14 days of the purchase.
I am a happy camper.
[ATTS] Thats bloody fantastic, didnt know coupd do that
[smartialarts] Yeah, when I was asking them to do the price match they mentioned it when I tried to haggle (saying that I'd be getting a TCB cashback from Amazon as well)
Funny enough, I find no mention of this "goodwill" thing on their website.
[ATTS] @smartialarts: Nice probs on case by case basis maybe?

[ATTS] @payton
Any idea which better features this has over the epix 2 pro?
Any idea if the pro version will be on sale soon also?
[tightm8] If you’re asking then you probably don’t need this. Trust me, 99.99% of users are better off keeping their current watch. I have the Epix 2 as well and very happy with it.
[ATTS] Yep its not a "need" its a want :D 😀
For some reqson I really like garmin watches
I bought an epix 2 pro just to tide me over, i was planning to get a fenix 8 pro sometime next year, been waiting for sale lol since i dont like wastage of funds
[Larz24] PSA for anyone considering this and coming from a Fenix 7 / Epix Pro Gen 2. This watch has been a frustrating experience with consistent bugs over the last year of ownership (Bluetooth music dropouts, maps crashes and general random reboots). Also as the software has been updated over the months, the watch has got considerably slower (I’m not the only one facing this, see the Garmin forums). On average for a 8-10km run it can take 5-10 seconds to save a workout compared to 2-3 on my old Epix. Also navigating the watch and raise to wake has occasional lag as well. For the asking price - I don’t think it’s acceptable.
The new consolidated UI code base has been a disaster and I’m also seeing reports of Fenix 9 users experiencing much the same.
[h3blade] trust me MIP is much better. waiting fenix 9 pro. my fenix 7 pro still going strong
[ATTS] Curious what is ur opinion on the older fenix 6 pro
[alphas] It's great, I owned one for about 4 years. I had a problem with the screen that would show up randomly but still totally usable. I reached out to Garmin support because I thought it might be software related and even though the warranty was over 2 years expired they offered to replace with a fenix 7 pro for $300.
[ATTS] @alphas: Nice thanks
Im really loving garmin haha,
[alphas] The fenix that came out before the fenix 8
[ATTS] U reckon the fenix 9 pro is way better thenthe fenix 8 pro?
Thinking should i get the 8 pro next year or 9 pro in 2 years?
[jackwilk] Tempted, but happy with my Epix 2 pro. Fenix 8 has a speaker and a newer supported interface. That's pretty much it for differences?
[ATTS] Thanks, curious are people using the speaker for calls and music? Any other good uses?
[jackwilk] I use my samsung ultra to take calls, it's not that bad. Also it gives me voice announcements when I go jogging, my Epix 2 pro just beeps at me instead.
The watch speaker is pretty crappy for music.
